xmldoc.short_description: Truth-table lookup: an N-bit input vector indexes a 2^N-entry TruthTable.

description.p: Truth-table lookup: an N-bit input vector indexes a 2^N-entry TruthTable.

The single input is a vector of N boolean elements that forms a binary index (element 0 is the most-significant bit); the output is TruthTable[index], where TruthTable is a 2^N-entry column. Non-zero inputs count as 1. The block is registered vector-aware (it accepts a vector input and produces a scalar output).
Native runtime only: the vector-input row lookup is not yet code-generated. An out-of-range index or an empty table yields 0.

tr.td: Numeric signal read by the block.
Numeric signal produced by the block.

ul.li: ALGEBRAIC: index = sum over bits (u[i] != 0) * 2^(N-1-i); out = TruthTable[index].

description.p: Native runtime only (this block is not code-generated).
Code generation: supported for C and Rust.

example_item.example_item_description: A 2-input XOR truth table [0 1 1 0] applied to the vector [1 0] gives 1.
